notes.title: Development update #3 – Hairdressing crash course ✂️💈
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, Stylists 💇‍♀️
[/h3]

I know it’s been a while since we posted a development update, but don’t you worry – we’re constantly moving forward and creating new stuff to bring you fresh news straight from our Hairdresser salon.

We highly appreciate your interest in the game and always look forward to your feedback, so feel free to leave your opinion in the comments 🙌

[h3][b]What’s new?[/b][/h3]

Today I want to focus on a few classic hairdressing practices and show you, step by step, almost limitless options for our model makeover. It’s still a work in progress, but we’re constantly pushing forward. 

Without further ado, grab your scissors, we’re going to do some haircuts!

[h3][b]Sprinkling[/b][/h3]

We need to prepare our client for transformation. Let’s begin by slowly dousing the hair with water before we apply shampoo – it has to foam, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/6f207e7a7f58319ddab8923d40c9be5c2c629241.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Shampoo[/b][/h3]

Apply the shampoo with a brush. We don’t want to make the customer feel uncomfortable, so let's do it gently by massaging the scalp to fill the hair with foam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/1ca20cdff30159daee5deea3aef9fa08b5f8fb9b.gif[/img]

Now you can use a little force to help the foam cover every spot on the head.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/999a122db58d1b6d8d0f0e46afe9aa4537af436a.gif[/img]

Carefully wash off our model’s hair and let’s move on to the next step.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/cfea5459ece59e36f992283faf835164b1fc2af4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Drying[/b][/h3]

Now it’s time to blow dry the hair. Remember, we want to do it carefully and evenly. Remember, it’s best to keep the blow-dryer at least 20 cm away from the hair!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/76fb91f8bc5b986f83aa4e6d87043a0e613880e3.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Brushing[/b][/h3]

Alright, before we get to the most exciting part, we need to prepare hair to be properly styled. Brushing is important because we separate specific strands of hair, which help us at work. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/22f52fa80357eb697dd0d3db59a5352c8fa00282.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Hair clipping[/b][/h3]

Properly brushed hair is now much easier to clip. Use our Hair elastic and tie up the strands you don’t want to cut.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/c9807e47783b94a871b191d7d974670312d985fb.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Straightening[/b][/h3]

You have to be prepared that your customer might want to straighten some things out. That’s why we prepared a useful tool for you, to fulfill the desire for straight hair. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/07ea00b8c98bba96d6720fac9397856652291913.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/05c72500b4116d557e9529a85ed7998bea12dc85.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Coloring[/b][/h3]

Almost everybody enjoys changing things up now and then… 
Sometimes it’s a new car, a new pair of shoes or a new job. 
But there is another way to turn your life around! — Show your customers these colorful hairstyles… before they make some other drastic life decisions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/0cd4ce642440048b6b04a1db282ad994da2bf694.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/5ccaf686e6d6a36fc2549d3790de166300023afd.gif[/img]
                                  [i]pssst: that rainbow is just a showcase of possibilities[/i] 🤫

[h3][b]Cutting[/b][/h3]

Okay, we’ve made it to the most iconic point in the journey of every hairdresser. 
That means we’re going to cut some hair!
Be careful – it’s a very precise job. One mistake and the whole hairstyle is ruined. 

Grab the section of hair you wish, hold it with a comb, adjust the length, and make one smooth cut. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/ec82ef605a72575ed273d0b9fc8ed598a3eb4f86.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/b8099a99f32ddebcf086fa287a56f947f4dc0156.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Advice[/b][/h3]

We know that an even cut is easier achieved on wet hair, but we thought it would be interesting to show you that in Hairdresser Simulator it’s possible to make it on dry hair as well.

PS: This was just a showcase, no customers were injured during the photoshoot.

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

Alright, we’ve made it to the end of this development update. I hope you liked our little hairdressing showcase. As I’ve mentioned in the beginning, we’re constantly improving each aspect of our game, so you can rest assured that we’ll be back in another devlog soon!

If you want to keep up to date, follow us on social media and wishlist on our Steam Page. 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/ 

Meanwhile, keep styling!

~Hairdresser Team

notes.content:
Hello there, Hairdressers!

It’s been a long time since we’ve released any update regarding Hairdresser Simulator. Many of you can’t wait to see new updates, so we're here to deliver you fresh news from our hairdressing salon. 

First things first, we’re still developing a Hairdresser Simulator, so there is nothing to worry about. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028342/9f73061ddcd16f72fbb0fb0b6da8f3ff6fa977e7.jpg[/img]

In Hairdresser Simulator, you will be able to customize your hairdressing salon completely, but first, you have to prove that you are one of the best (if not the best) existing hairdressers on the market. To do that, you need to start from the very beginning, but that doesn’t mean you can’t aim higher. Constantly improve your skills, follow current trends, and expand your brand further to encourage your old and new customers to visit your salon. 

You also need to remember about self-development, as this will help you claim the top spot in the hairdressing industry.
